thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT gpu_capacity_exhaustion customer-vpc-99 queued_requests=2140 (>1500), p95_token_latency=5.2s, error_rate_5m=6.0%

oncall-nina: Acknowledged. Who's on call for this cluster? Any recent deploys?

sre-oliver: Private VPC customer-vpc-99. Autoscaler attempted scale-up 4x -> all failed with `QuotaExceeded` for a100 GPUs from provider. No in-cluster deploys in last 2h.

infra-lee: Cloud API returns 403 / quota_exceeded for gpu.a100 in eu-central-1. Also seeing registry 429 rate-limits causing image pull backoff (~30-70s). Both factors slow node readiness.

oncall-nina: OK. Quick mitigation options? Evict low-priority pods, route to hosted fallback, or enable mixed-instance fallback. What's customer policy?

customer-eng-marta: On call with ops at the customer. They strongly prefer no mixed-instance (a100-only workloads), and they don't accept preemptible hardware. They asked to minimize data plane changes.

pm-ana: Given SLA, prioritize throughput with minimal model changes. Hosted fallback is preferred if acceptable. Also need to quantify impact for post-incident note.

incident-bot: ACTION evict_noncritical_jobs triggered by sre-oliver at 4301007005.

sre-oliver: Running eviction: `kubectl delete pod -l app=background-job -n customer-vpc-99` ~120 pods removed. Queue dropped 2140 -> 1680 in ~6m.

oncall-nina: Better but still above critical. I'm going to enable a short-lived hosted split for new requests (30%), and add dedupe header so client retries don't double-charge.

infra-lee: Hosted split added in gateway. Routing payload used: `{"customer":"customer-vpc-99","split_pct":30,"fallback":"redwood-hosted:compat","dedupe_header":"x-rw-dedup"}`. Start time 4301007132.

incident-bot: ROUTING NOTE: 510 requests routed to hosted in last 9m.

customer-eng-marta: Customer accepted hosted split under protest. They want sticky session maintained for contextful models. Sticking sessions enabled for fallback.

pm-ana: Also throttle large batch ingests for this customer (block >50k tokens) until recovered. Those batches are the main driver of queue dives.

infra-lee: Tried a soft autoscaler backoff tweak to be more aggressive but cloud API still returns 403 for new instances. Opened provider ticket (support-2289) via portal; automated response says estimate unknown. Provider-support-bot logged ticket id.

provider-support-bot: Ticket support-2289 created with provider. Initial triage: quota request under business review; no immediate quota bump.

oncall-nina: Because customer disallows preemptible and mixed-instance, our options limited. Keep hosted split, continue evictions, and contact customer about quota request process.

sre-oliver: Added a temporary nodepool pre-pull attempt to reduce image pull time by using cached images on warm nodes, but registry throttles still cause delayed readiness for new nodes. Command snippets in runbook.

sre-oliver: Key commands I used:
```
# evict background jobs
kubectl delete pod -l app=background-job -n customer-vpc-99
# cordon nodepool to stop new large batch scheduling
kubectl cordon nodepool-a100-*-n -n customer-vpc-99
# enable hosted split
curl -X POST https://gw.internal/routing/split -d '{"customer":"customer-vpc-99","split_pct":30,"fallback":"redwood-hosted:compat","dedupe_header":"x-rw-dedup"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP'
```

oncall-nina: Handing off to night SRE in 20m. Handoff notes: keep fallback active until queued_requests < 250 for 30m, continue evicting nonessential jobs, escalate provider ticket every 2h, do not change model precision without PM approval.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE severity=high, start=4301006789, mitigation=partial_hosted_split+evictions, assigned=[oncall-nina,sre-oliver,infra-lee].

customer-eng-marta: Customer reports visible improvement for routed sessions but older clients still spike queue due to aggressive retries. Recommended they update client backoff; we added header `x-rw-client-advice:increase-backoff` on responses routed to hosted.

pm-ana: Action items: 1) Add quota-health alert at 75% usage for customer accounts. 2) Document fallback policy and sticky session guarantees for private clusters. 3) Schedule post-incident customer call.

infra-lee: Metrics at 4301007399: queued_requests=210, p95=1.2s, error_rate_5m=0.5%.

sre-kyla: Picking up handoff. Will monitor and keep fallback until thresholds met. If provider clears quota, we'll attempt controlled scale-up then drain hosted split. If provider denies, coordinate with PM/customer for config changes.

oncall-nina: Thanks team. I'll write the initial internal stub and link this thread. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: HANDOFF oncall-nina -> sre-kyla at 4301007420. Auto-archive in 72h if no updates.
